checks: One fetch call per attempted exchange; no CLI lookup or child process
Exact HTTPS origin; refuse other hostname, URL credentials, query and fragment before any exchange
Caller cannot override automation bypass, host or cookies; private bearer preserved
Redirects and retries disabled; refused redirect becomes uncertainty
Timeout at most 12000 ms; streamed body and exposed UTF-8 headers at most 1048576 bytes
UTF-8 request payload hash and response body/header byte counters
Bypass and bearer absent from measurement metadata and sanitized transport errors
Oversized stream cancelled; aborted caller produces no exchange
